about: The overlay's slot table (amendment 16 §19, D-523, C-66): each slot label poe2db prints before a socketable's line, mapped to PoB's slot keys, the second-level keys of the pinned Data/ModRunes.lua. Built from the pinned corpus, the in-pin socketables of data/league/runes-of-aldur.md against Data/ModRunes.lua, by matching each labelled line's text with the keys whose lines hold it; where a line is the same on several keys, the label keeps the keys its other lines show. tests/static/leagueOverlay.test.ts checks it against the pin. A label the table lacks makes league-digest.mjs skip the socketable and list it.
